Reads online-retail-dataset.csv (516,384 rows); the new table 'training_retail_win_back' would have 1,402 rows and 8 columns. Left out, of the file's 4,331 shoppers: 971 have no activity on or before 31 Aug 2011, so they were not known by then; 1,958 were active in the 90 days before 31 Aug 2011, so they have not gone quiet. Who is kept is the audience you chose. It is cut at 31 Aug 2011: the 90 days after it give the outcome, and 30 Nov 2011 is the date your case is read at.
Prepare 1 file with 5 changes for the goal “Retail Win-back”. Nothing else changes.
